name: captains-cabinet-marketplace
description: Distribution channel for the Captains Cabinet plugin and its preset variants. Authoritative source for plugin install paths.

plugins.name: captains-cabinet
plugins.description: Full Captains Cabinet plugin: framework + presets (work, portfolio, personal, step-network) + 20 skills + 11 slash commands + 7 MCP servers. The officer fleet is roster-derived (instance/config/roster.yml) — the work preset ships 8 role archetypes, the portfolio preset ships the Chair plus generated lane CEOs.

plugins.name: captains-cabinet-personal
plugins.description: Personal Cabinet variant — coaching-focused, lighter governance, Captain triplet only. Selects the personal preset via instance/config/active-preset at first run.
